properties.summary: The magnetic moment is consistent with two Nd3+ ions and one Tb3+ ion; the heterolanthanide products are reported to show no intramolecular magnetic coupling at room temperature.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A flat inorganic core of two Nd and one Tb atoms linked by a bridging S2N2 dithiadiazine fragment. The Tb site is additionally bridged to one Nd by S2; the other Nd is coordinated by adjacent S and N atoms of the dithiadiazine fragment, forming an Nd–N–S three-membered ring.

synthesis.procedure: A suspension of [(NdI)3N2(THF)6] (266 mg, 0.178 mmol), TbI3(THF)3 (96 mg, 0.127 mmol), and sulfur (25 mg, 0.78 mmol) in THF (17 mL) was stirred in an ultrasonic bath for 10 h at 60 °C. The mixture was centrifuged, and the yellow solution was separated by decantation. Slow evaporation of THF gave a mixture of crystals; orange crystals of cluster 3 were mechanically separated, washed with cold THF, and dried under reduced pressure.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: ultrasonic bath; manipulations under vacuum using standard Schlenk techniques or in an argon-filled glovebox
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Centrifugation and decantation; slow evaporation of THF; orange crystals mechanically separated, washed with cold THF, and dried under reduced pressure.

properties.summary: The magnetic moment is reported to agree with the Nd/Tm composition; the heterolanthanide products are reported to show no intramolecular magnetic coupling at room temperature.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Isostructural to cluster 3: a flat inorganic core of two Nd and one Tm atoms linked by a bridging S2N2 dithiadiazine fragment. The Tm site is additionally bridged to one Nd by S2; the other Nd is coordinated by adjacent S and N atoms of the dithiadiazine fragment, forming an Nd–N–S three-membered ring.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared similarly to cluster 3, using [(NdI)3N2(THF)6] (216 mg, 0.130 mmol), TmI3(THF)3 (126 mg, 0.164 mmol), and sulfur (25 mg, 0.78 mmol) in THF (17 mL); the suspension was treated in an ultrasonic bath at 60 °C for 10 h. Yellow-orange crystals were isolated.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: ultrasonic bath; manipulations under vacuum using standard Schlenk techniques or in an argon-filled glovebox
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Reaction and isolation described as similar to cluster 3; yellow-orange crystals obtained, with one crystal used for X-ray analysis.

title: Heterolanthanide three-nuclear iodide-sulfide-nitride clusters. Unusual synthesis way and structure
